scope: Fixed40 root Web SDK, normal diagnostic/qualification OFF B4348 versus C, DPR2 primary; DPR4 correctness plus descriptive timings. Final matching-source probe builds provide attribution in a separate lane.

definitions.active_tail: Each case primary erase: [actual Up dispatch start -2000ms, actual Up dispatch start). Include every SDK rAF callback in the interval, including preparation/retry callbacks. Report number, durations, intervals, actual erase duration and no-display intervals; do not select only fast painted frames.
definitions.active_owner_Render: In matched probe lane, identify owner attempts/Render calls and actual content submissions in the same tail, retain all attempts including retry/refused. Exclusive and inclusive durations separate; nested scopes are not added twice. Report paired medians/p95 and counts.
definitions.postUp_first_owner: First owner/Render attempt servicing feedback with final sealed suffix after Up return, including deferred metadata/query work. Report Up handler separately. First accepted content and contribution identity reported separately from attempted render.
definitions.postUp_first_RAF: First SDK rAF callback after Up return including its full duration, not just draw/GL call.
definitions.first_feedback: From planned first nonzero twofinger Move to first actual content submission on the intended target at changed camera, carrying current erase suffix or committed equivalent. GL+cached public camera proxy is qualified separately by native/readback, not photons.
definitions.max_gap: Origin->first valid changed-camera content, successive distinct current-camera valid contents, final content->input end; include initial dispatch delay, never count stale-camera repeats.
definitions.percentile: Nearest rank ceil(p*N), retain per-replicate samples. Relative checks pool raw samples per role/case then percentile; maxima use worst maximum, not median-of-maxima.
definitions.input: Record planned time, actual JS dispatch start/end, touch CDP roundtrip separately, public camera adoption, SDK rAF full callback; where existing private probes permit, record C++ handler and owner/frame correlation. No reentrant Runtime/SDK read inside GL hooks.

blocking_targets.normal_active_tail_RAF_duration_p95: For each of four case IDs, pooled C p95 <= max(16.7ms, 0.80 * pooled B p95). 20% material improvement above one-frame floor.
blocking_targets.normal_first_postUp_RAF_duration: For each case ID, worst C first-post-Up SDK rAF duration <= max(33ms, 0.80 * worst B). Record synchronous Up duration too.
blocking_targets.matched_probe_active_Render: Each immediate pan/pinch case: C active-tail Render median <=0.80*B median and p95 <=max(33ms,0.90*B p95). Complete phase sums/residuals and all attempted/painted counts disclosed.
blocking_targets.primary_navigation: Each C ordinary replicate immediate pan/pinch: first feedback <=100ms; maximum content gap <=100ms; SDK rAF interval p95 <=33ms including initial planned input delay.
blocking_targets.primary_input_backlog: Each immediate case pooled C navigation inputlateness p95 <=max(16.7ms,0.80*B p95). This is a scheduling/backlog proxy, not pure Runtime CPU or physical input latency.
blocking_targets.settled_nonregression: C dispatch/SDK rAF interval p95 <=max(B*1.15,B+5ms); maxcontentgap <=max(100ms,B+16.7ms).
blocking_targets.other_nonregression: For every case, active Move handler p95, Up handler, CDP roundtrip p95 <=max(B*1.15,B+5ms); actual primary erase/navigation duration <=max(B*1.05,B+50ms); convergence median <=max(B*1.15,B+50ms). Disclose max and Up->commit->visible.
blocking_targets.correctness_and_memory: All EFF3 rules and charged GPU/snapshot lifetime checks pass under same B/C memory profile. No improvements obtained through missing inputs, unaccounted surfaces or incomplete feedback.

ordinary_observer: Exact observer v2 as reference. May add explicit primary and post-Up boundaries and raw analysis. No new state reads in GL hooks, no global sampler rAF, no GPU waits/readbacks/profiler/held Worker in ordinary. B and C share exact final driver/observer/config.
claim_limits: No guaranteed success from expected source mechanism; unmet frozen target is UNMET.
Diagnostic CPU submit time is not GPU execution duration. A zero coverage counter does not prove zero GPU work.
Do not round old 103.13ms down to100ms, discard slow runs or rerun to select a pass.
No whole G5, release or other-platform ABI pass.
